title: Exercise cancellation inside a running received-source observer and its Git child
outcome: Received-notice tests distinguish cancellation before observer execution from cancellation during source work and before publication.
acceptance: A deterministic test parks inside TEST_RECEIVED_NOTICE_SOURCE_READ after run() starts, cancels the owner, and proves publish_received_launcher_notice does not rewrite advice.

An independently controlled pinned-Git child cancellation case verifies existing CaptureLifetime ownership and cleanup without raising production budgets or claiming queued cancellation covers an in-flight child.
